#Blueface Shows His Loyalty While Revealing He NO LONGER Responds To Other Women On His PHONE Due To Him Recently PROPOSING To Chrisean 💍👀🥹

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Porter, is a 29-year-old rapper, entertainer, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. He first gained mainstream attention in 2018 with his viral track “Respect My Cryppin’” before becoming a household name with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which reached No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100. Known for his unconventional offbeat flow, outspoken personality, and viral social media moments, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable figures in West Coast hip-hop. Beyond music, he has gained millions of followers through livestreaming, reality television, and his highly publicized relationships. His on-and-off relationship with Chrisean Rock has consistently made headlines, with the two sharing a son, Chrisean Jr. Recently, Blueface has sparked even more attention after reportedly proposing to Chrisean Rock and revealing that he no longer responds to other women on his phone following the proposal. 

Who Is Chrisean Rock?

Chrisean Rock, whose real name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a 26-year-old rapper, reality television star, and social media personality from Baltimore, Maryland. She first gained recognition through her connection with Blueface before building her own following through music, viral social media moments, and appearances on the Zeus Network reality series Baddies. She later starred alongside Blueface in their reality show Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love, which documented their highly publicized relationship. Outside of television, Chrisean has released several songs, including “Vibe,” which helped establish her presence in the music industry. In September 2023, she welcomed her first child, Chrisean Jr., with Blueface. Despite years of public disagreements, breakups, and reconciliations, their relationship continues to attract significant attention online. Most recently, the two have sparked renewed conversations about their future together following Blueface’s reported marriage proposal.
